# Tutorials

Each topic has lesson notes — the steps, vocabulary and pseudocode — and, where recorded, video tutorials in Blender and in Rhino + Grasshopper. Use them to review a class or catch up. The slides and example files are on each [class page]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/classes/overview/).
